checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.description: We sent you a link to confirm your account. Open it on this device or another one.
checkEmail.notReceived: Didn't get it? Check your spam folder or ask for another link.

verifyEmail.resent: If that email has an account waiting for confirmation, we sent a new link.

forgotPassword.description: Enter your email address. If it matches an account, we'll send you a link to reset your password.

resetPassword.title: Reset your password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.

account.title: My account
account.signOutEverywhereDescription: Every session you have ends, this one included. You'll sign in again on each device.
account.sessionsDescription: Your session ends on its own after 30 minutes without activity.
account.noCompanyTitle: You don't have a company yet
account.noCompanyDescription: Set it up to start issuing documents. If you were invited, open the link in the email.

onboarding.title: Set up your company
onboarding.description: We create your real company and a test copy. You'll start in the test copy, where you can issue test documents right away.
onboarding.rucHint: 13 digits, as shown on your RUC.
onboarding.tradeNameHint: Optional. Shown instead of the legal name.
onboarding.certificateHint: Your .p12 file and its password. It must belong to the RUC above. We store the private key encrypted.
onboarding.logoHint: Optional. PNG, JPEG or GIF up to 500 KB, for your RIDEs.
onboarding.branchAddressHint: Leave it empty to use the main address.

onboardingError.INVALID_RUC: That RUC isn't valid. Check the 13 digits.
onboardingError.RUC_TAKEN: A company with that RUC already exists.
onboardingError.CERTIFICATE_INVALID: That file isn't a valid .p12 signature.
onboardingError.CERTIFICATE_KEY_NOT_FOUND: The signature doesn't contain a key matching its certificate.
onboardingError.CERTIFICATE_EXPIRED: The signature has expired or is not valid yet. Renew it with your certificate authority.
onboardingError.CERTIFICATE_RUC_MISMATCH: The signature doesn't belong to this RUC.
onboardingError.INVALID_LOGO: The logo must be a PNG, JPEG or GIF image up to 500 KB.
onboardingError.UNKNOWN: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

nav.productionAfterGoLive: Available once your company goes live.

shell.sandboxBody: Documents go to the SRI test environment and have no tax validity.
shell.certificateExpiredBody: You can't issue documents until you renew it with your certificate authority and upload the new one.

shell.certificateExpiringBody: Renew it with your certificate authority and upload the new one before it expires.

dashboard.description: Sales, purchasing and inventory will appear here as they are built.
dashboard.welcomeBody: You're in its test copy: issue test documents without affecting your real company.
dashboard.goLiveBody: When you're done testing, take your company live.
dashboard.liveBody: You're working in the real company. Switch to Test whenever you want to try something.

users.title: Users
users.description: Who works with your company and what they can do. Changes apply to the test copy too.
users.inviteDescription: We'll send a link to join, valid for 7 days.
users.issuePointsHint: With none checked, they can use all of them.
users.removed: The person was removed from the company.

removeDialog.title: Remove from the company?
removeDialog.description: They'll lose access to the company and its test copy. You can invite them again later.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke the invitation?
revokeDialog.description: The link that was sent will stop working.

users.requireTwoFactor: Require two-step verification of every member
users.requireTwoFactorHint: Anyone without it will have to turn it on before they keep working.
users.seatUsageUnlimited: {used} users, no limit on your plan
users.seatsFull: Your plan allows {seats, plural, one {# user} other {# users}}, and all are taken, counting pending invitations.

usersError.OWNER_PROTECTED: The owner only changes through a transfer.
usersError.CANNOT_CHANGE_SELF: You can't change your own role or remove yourself.

usersError.UNKNOWN_ISSUE_POINT: One of the issue points doesn't exist.
usersError.RATE_LIMITED: Too many invitations. Wait a few minutes.

noAccess.title: You don't have access
noAccess.description: Your role doesn't include this section. Ask the owner or an administrator for access.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.codeHint: The 6 digits from your app, or a backup code.

security.title: Security
security.description: Two-step verification asks for a code from your authenticator app as well as your password.
security.passwordToEnable: Your password, to turn it on
security.passwordToDisable: Your password, to turn it off
security.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or another).
security.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
security.backupHint: Keep them somewhere safe. Each works once if you lose your phone. You won't see them again.
security.requiredByOrganization: Your company requires two-step verification. Turn it on to continue.

securityError.INVALID_CODE: That code isn't valid. Check your phone's clock and try again.
securityError.TWO_FACTOR_LOCKED: Too many wrong codes. Wait 15 minutes.

audit.title: Activity
audit.description: Who did what, and when, in this company. Entries can't be edited or deleted.

subscription.module_removed: scheduled the removal of the module
subscription.limit_cleared: returned a limit to the plan value

audit.emptyHint: You'll see who changed what in the company here, such as invitations, roles and plan changes.

goLive.title: Take {organization} live
goLive.description: Your real company will start issuing documents with tax validity.
goLive.point1: The real company's documents will go to the SRI production environment.
goLive.point2: Your test copy stays available for testing, separate from the real one.
goLive.point4: Before the first document we'll ask for starting numbers, if you're moving from another provider.
goLive.confirm: I understand this step can't be undone.

goLiveError.FORBIDDEN: Only the owner can take the company live.
goLiveError.UNKNOWN: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

legal.description: The terms that govern your company's use of Comprobify, personalized with its details.
legal.underReview: The legal documents are under review and will be published soon.
legal.acceptLabel: I've read and accept, on behalf of my company, the Terms of Service, the Privacy Policy and the Data Processing Agreement.
legal.ownerAccepts: The company's owner must accept them.

legalError.AGREEMENTS_DISABLED: The legal documents are under review.

featureLocked.descriptionAsk: Ask the company owner or an administrator to add it to the plan.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: What your company's plan includes and how much of each limit you use.
plan.changeSoon: Soon you'll be able to change plan and add modules here.

admin.noMatches: No company matches the search. Try the full RUC.
admin.noCompanies: They'll show here once someone sets theirs up.
admin.changePlanDescription: Applies at once to the company and its test copy.
admin.complimentaryHint: Never charged, never renews or expires. Recorded with the reason.
admin.priceDescription: Before VAT. Billing charges it from the next renewal.

admin.addOnsDescription: Added at once. When removed, the company keeps them until next month starts.

admin.removeModuleDescription: The company keeps it until next month starts. You can cancel before then.
admin.limitsCustom: Custom's own values. Without one, the plan's value applies.
admin.limitsPlan: They come from the plan and exceptions. For own values, use Custom.
admin.limitCleared: The limit is back to the plan's value.

admin.clearOverrideDescription: The company goes back to what its plan and modules give it.
admin.resolvedDescription: What the company has today, combined.

catalog.plansDescription: What is sold: modules and limits. Ordered as customers see them.
catalog.modulesPageDescription: The groups of features that are sold. A feature can be in several modules.
catalog.newPlanDescription: Starts as a draft, with the base module and the Free limits.
catalog.newModuleDescription: Starts as coming soon: it grants nothing until you publish it.
catalog.keyHint: Upper case, no spaces, like BUSINESS_PLUS. It can not change later.
catalog.selfServiceHint: If not, only the platform assigns it, like Custom.
catalog.planStatusHint: A published plan never goes back to draft; retired stops being offered, but its companies keep it.
catalog.moduleStatusHint: An available module never goes back to coming soon: every company would lose it at once.
catalog.modulesDraft: A draft with no companies: changes apply at once.
catalog.modulesNotice: Adding applies at once. Removing is announced 30 days ahead and reaches each company at its next month.
catalog.addModuleNow: The plan's companies get it at once.
catalog.removeModuleTitle: Remove the module from the plan?
catalog.removeModuleDraft: It's a draft, so it is removed at once.
catalog.removeModuleNotice: Companies keep it for 30 days, then until their next month starts. You can cancel before then.
catalog.limitsDraft: A draft with no companies: changes apply at once.
catalog.limitsNotice: Raising a limit applies at once. Lowering one is announced 30 days ahead, so no company is suddenly over it.
catalog.featuresSoon: It's coming soon and grants nothing yet: changes apply at once.
catalog.featuresNotice: Adding applies at once. Removing is announced 30 days ahead.
catalog.addFeatureNow: Companies with this module get it at once.
catalog.removeFeatureTitle: Remove the feature from the module?
catalog.removeFeatureSoon: The module is coming soon, so it is removed at once.
catalog.removeFeatureNotice: Companies keep it for 30 days, then until their next month starts.

catalogError.FORBIDDEN: Only platform administration can do this.

catalogError.BASE_MODULE_REQUIRED: Every plan keeps the base module.
